title: Denver Invisalign Patients Can Now Learn All About Icon Dental's Clear Aligner Care Online | User | wapakdailynews.com
text:
The practice recently updated its clear aligners service page, making it a one-stop resource for patients seeking expert-driven, technology-enhanced orthodontic care.
DENVER - March 26, 2025 - PRLog -- Icon Dental, a leading provider of advanced dental care in downtown Denver, is reinforcing its commitment to expert-driven, patient-centered orthodontic care. With the recent revamp of its clear aligners service page, the practice now offers a comprehensive resource to educate and empower patients exploring clear braces in Denver.
"Straightening your teeth isn't just about aesthetics—it's about achieving long-term oral health with precision and comfort," said Dr. Nazeli Tarjan, DDS, owner of Icon Dental and a Platinum Invisalign Provider. "At Icon Dental, we blend cutting-edge technology with a compassionate, personalized approach to ensure every patient feels confident in their journey to a better smile."
Icon Dental provides both Invisalign® and SureSmile® clear aligners, offering customized treatment plans to fit patients' unique dental needs. The practice incorporates the latest orthodontic advancements, including:
- 3D Digital Scanning: Eliminating messy impressions, this technology captures fast and accurate images for a perfect aligner fit.
- Digital Treatment Planning: Patients can preview their smile transformation before treatment begins.
- PROPEL Orthodontics: In select cases, this technology accelerates tooth movement, potentially reducing treatment time.
Understanding that dental anxiety can be a barrier to treatment, Icon Dental prioritizes patient comfort at every step. The practice is known for its welcoming, family-like environment and tailored care, ensuring that each patient receives the attention and expertise they deserve.
About Icon Dental
Located in the heart of downtown Denver,
Icon Dentaldelivers cutting-edge, patient-centered dental care in a welcoming and family-oriented atmosphere. Led by Dr. Nazeli Tarjan, DDS, the practice offers a full spectrum of modern dental services, including Invisalign and SureSmile clear aligners, cosmetic dentistry, and preventive care. With a focus on advanced technology, compassionate service, and a stress-free experience, Icon Dental helps patients achieve optimal dental health and confident smiles.
